The rule states the document is the legal instrument only for different-entity. For same-entity with spelling drift, either could be canonical. Verdict: same-entity, best_value "ESIT Elektronik Ltd.", why: Elektronik/Electronics is spelling drift and Ltd. is a legal-suffix drift, same company; keep the certificate's legal form.
